changelog: REPLAY: Provider archive playback now tries TS, HLS, and legacy Xtream endpoints across the enabled player recovery ladder.
PREMIUM: Phone-safe layout keeps guide and touch controls clear of system bars; player defaults to aspect-fit with tap, double-tap seek, and long-press aspect controls.
WINDOWS: Movie, series, and Live TV category selectors now open above clipped panels and provide a large scrollable picker.
